review.label_firewall: Immutable six-field cache includes training targets only; metadata is projected to ID/month, and inherited adapter receives all-NaN held targets. No training method reads raw held truth. Scoring remains separate.
review.scaling: Original training-only encoder/layout and clipped10800 population target mean/std are reconstructed and checked against saved preprocessing before any teacher/update. Same156+12 features and unchanged tracks.
review.teacher: Frozen original seed42 checkpoint in eval mode; cached unclipped standardized32-head mean. Every held mean is transformed to seconds and must reproduce original float32 outputs exactly. No EMA, selected pseudo targets or teacher fitting.
review.view: Fixed endpoint-preserving compact selection, prefix masks and retained slot quality only; source descriptors and preceding raw gap retained. Existing physical layer recomputes selected adjacency. Full sparse-observation invariance is not assumed.
review.updates: All arms start from identical retained state and fresh AdamW3e-5/.0003. Same seed42 permutation and supervised dropout streams, actual-row microbatch weights, one optimizer update per2048logical examples. Additional512eval-mode consistency pass uses separate PCG64 cycles and preserves every module flag/CPU/CUDA RNG. Twoepochs, no monitor or schedule.
review.controls: Original supervised loss is unchanged; zero-weight helper is strict no-op and CPU checks show output/gradient/RNG/first-update equality. Actual target-input candidate is compared against both fixed continuations and actualv80.
review.state: States and complete terminal optimizer/RNG/sampler state save before predictions; completed fits never rerun, partial unrecorded fits fail closed. Full saved-model prediction reload required.
review.memory: Preflight reserves real train/held tensors and original track geometry while testing complete4microbatch+consistency512 update. Reject above7GiB; no resizing rule.
review.provenance: Frozen parent sources/models/inputs and reviewer/independent fixture pinned. Scorer freeze must precede fitting and independent actual prefit audit must bind identity/preflight/teachers before root fit allocation.

tests: Independent129length scalar mapping, analytic32-head mean MSE gradient, sampler cycle, exception mode/RNG restore passed. Original separate CPU proof covers real model finite gradients and zero-update parity. No actual data/teacher/GPU inference or fit performed by this review.
limitations: Fresh optimizer cannot recover original missing optimizer state; matched controls explicitly share this reset.
Teacher can be biased; improved consistency is not predictive validation.
Retained full-source descriptors mean this is branch regularization, not realistic receiver outage simulation.
Held inputs are used transductively, and Jan/Jul are reused development. No independent statistical confirmation or performance claim.
